portInfo.description: ThPA markets Northern Greece excursions (Pella, Vergina, Athos, Amphipolis) alongside a walkable city call. Alexander the Great terminal (~2,000 m²) opened to expand Pier 2 capacity (press 2023).

gettingThere.fromTerminal: Thessaloniki cruise terminals (Makedonia + Alexander the Great)
gettingThere.distanceToCity: City centre described as adjacent — still verify walking route from your assigned pier.
gettingThere.distanceAnswer: City centre described as adjacent — still verify walking route from your assigned pier.
gettingThere.publicTransport: Confirm local transport options with the ship on your call date.

thingsToDo.intro: Pick one neighbourhood or excursion scale and keep time for the gangway queue on the way back.
thingsToDo.shortCall: Stay near the port area and keep a generous buffer before all-aboard.
thingsToDo.standardCall: Combine a central walk, one attraction, and lunch if times allow—start back well before all-aboard.
thingsToDo.longerCall: A second stop or coach outing is realistic only with confirmed transport and an eight-hour or longer window.
thingsToDo.practicalTip: Check whether you are on Pier 1 or Pier 2 before assuming a five-minute stroll.
